categories.name: utils
categories.evidence: Modifies `BufferedWriter` in `src/streams.h` to avoid throwing exceptions during destruction on write failure.
categories.rationale: Prevents process termination from an exception thrown in `BufferedWriter`'s destructor. When underlying stream writes fail, flushing in the destructor triggers `std::terminate` rather than normal error handling.

categories.name: validation
categories.evidence: Modifies `BlockManager::WriteBlock` and `BlockManager::WriteBlockUndo` in `src/node/blockstorage.cpp` to ensure disk write errors are caught cleanly.
categories.rationale: Ensures disk write failures during block and undo writes trigger clean fatal error handling instead of an immediate crash. On disk-full conditions, short writes previously caused the process to abort via `std::terminate`.
